---
format:
  typst: default
---

```{=typst}
#let ink = rgb("#000000")
#let paper = rgb("#FFFFFF")

#set page(
  paper: "us-letter",
  flipped: true,
  margin: (top: 0.24in, bottom: 0.38in, x: 0.42in),
  footer: context [
    #set text(
      font: ("Arial", "Liberation Sans", "DejaVu Sans"),
      size: 6.5pt,
      fill: ink,
      hyphenate: false,
    )
    #grid(
      columns: (1fr, auto),
      column-gutter: 10pt,
      [Technology Commons - Weekly Progress + Learning Skills - B&W],
      [Page #counter(page).display("1 of 1", both: true)]
    )
  ]
)

#set text(
  font: ("Arial", "Liberation Sans", "DejaVu Sans"),
  size: 10pt,
  fill: ink,
  hyphenate: false,
)
#set par(leading: 0.44em, justify: false)

#let write-line() = line(length: 100%, stroke: 0.95pt + ink)
#let check-box() = rect(width: 9.5pt, height: 9.5pt, stroke: 1.15pt + ink, radius: 1pt)

#let brand-header(title, subtitle) = [
  #grid(
    columns: (1fr, 2.42in),
    column-gutter: 18pt,
    align: top,
    [
      #text(size: 23pt, weight: "bold", fill: ink)[#title]
      #v(1pt)
      #text(size: 10.6pt, weight: "bold", fill: ink)[#subtitle]
    ],
    [
      #grid(
        columns: (0.54in, 1fr),
        column-gutter: 8pt,
        align: horizon,
        [#image("technology-department-emblem.svg", width: 0.50in)],
        [
          #text(size: 8.5pt, weight: "bold", fill: ink)[Technology Commons]
          #linebreak()
          #text(size: 7.6pt, fill: ink)[Port Credit Secondary School]
        ],
      )
    ],
  )
  #v(2pt)
  #line(length: 0.68in, stroke: 3pt + ink)
  #v(1pt)
  #line(length: 100%, stroke: 1.35pt + ink)
]

#let info-row() = [
  #grid(
    columns: (auto, 1.35fr, auto, 0.86fr, auto, 0.94fr),
    column-gutter: 6pt,
    align: horizon,
    [#text(size: 9.6pt, weight: "bold")[Name:]], [#write-line()],
    [#text(size: 9.6pt, weight: "bold")[Course:]], [#write-line()],
    [#text(size: 9.6pt, weight: "bold")[Week of:]], [#write-line()],
  )
]

#let inline-line(label) = [
  #grid(
    columns: (auto, 1fr),
    column-gutter: 5pt,
    align: horizon,
    [#text(size: 8.6pt, weight: "bold", fill: ink)[#label]],
    [#write-line()]
  )
]

#let compact-check(label) = [
  #grid(
    columns: (1fr, auto),
    column-gutter: 4pt,
    align: horizon,
    [#text(size: 7.7pt, weight: "bold", fill: ink)[#label]],
    [#check-box()]
  )
]

#let evaluation-panel() = [
  #block(
    width: 100%,
    height: 100%,
    fill: paper,
    stroke: 1pt + ink,
    radius: 2pt,
    inset: (x: 7pt, y: 5pt),
  )[
    #text(size: 8.1pt, weight: "bold", fill: ink)[CHECK]
    #v(4pt)
    #grid(
      columns: (1fr, 1fr),
      column-gutter: 9pt,
      row-gutter: 5pt,
      [#compact-check([Neat])],
      [#compact-check([Detailed])],
      [#compact-check([Technical terms])],
      [#compact-check([Level 1-4])],
    )
  ]
]

#let evidence-area() = [
  #text(size: 8.8pt, weight: "bold", fill: ink)[Evidence: what did I accomplish or learn?]
  #v(4pt)
  #write-line()
  #v(8pt)
  #write-line()
  #v(8pt)
  #write-line()
]

#let daily-box(day) = block(
  width: 100%,
  height: 1.03in,
  stroke: 1.1pt + ink,
  radius: 2pt,
  inset: (x: 8pt, y: 5pt),
)[
  #grid(
    columns: (0.92fr, 1.22fr, 1.72in),
    column-gutter: 12pt,
    align: top,
    [
      #text(size: 11.7pt, weight: "bold", fill: ink)[#day]
      #v(3pt)
      #inline-line([Today's goal:])
      #v(4pt)
      #inline-line([How will I know?])
      #v(4pt)
      #inline-line([Worked with:])
    ],
    [#evidence-area()],
    [#evaluation-panel()]
  )
]

#brand-header([Weekly Progress Log], [Set the Goal. Follow the Way. Take Action.])
#v(3pt)
#info-row()
#v(4pt)
#grid(
  columns: (auto, 1fr),
  column-gutter: 10pt,
  align: horizon,
  [#text(size: 14.5pt, weight: "bold", fill: ink)[Daily Progress]],
  [#line(length: 100%, stroke: 1.8pt + ink)]
)
#v(4pt)

#daily-box([Monday])
#v(3pt)
#daily-box([Tuesday])
#v(3pt)
#daily-box([Wednesday])
#v(3pt)
#daily-box([Thursday])
#v(3pt)
#daily-box([Friday])

#pagebreak()

#let rating-panel() = [
  #block(
    width: 100%,
    height: 100%,
    fill: paper,
    stroke: 1pt + ink,
    radius: 2pt,
    inset: (x: 7pt, y: 5pt),
  )[
    #text(size: 7.7pt, weight: "bold", fill: ink)[SELF-RATING]
    #v(4pt)
    #grid(
      columns: (auto, auto, auto, auto, auto, auto, auto, auto),
      column-gutter: 4pt,
      align: horizon,
      [#text(size: 8pt, weight: "bold")[E]], [#check-box()],
      [#text(size: 8pt, weight: "bold")[G]], [#check-box()],
      [#text(size: 8pt, weight: "bold")[S]], [#check-box()],
      [#text(size: 8pt, weight: "bold")[N]], [#check-box()],
    )
  ]
]

#let skill-row(title, prompt) = block(
  width: 100%,
  height: 0.80in,
  stroke: 1.1pt + ink,
  radius: 2pt,
  inset: (x: 8pt, y: 5pt),
)[
  #grid(
    columns: (2.75in, 1fr, 2.05in),
    column-gutter: 12pt,
    align: top,
    [
      #text(size: 10.7pt, weight: "bold", fill: ink)[#title]
      #v(2pt)
      #text(size: 8.1pt, fill: ink)[#prompt]
    ],
    [
      #text(size: 8.6pt, weight: "bold", fill: ink)[My evidence or next step]
      #v(4pt)
      #write-line()
      #v(8pt)
      #write-line()
    ],
    [#rating-panel()]
  )
]

#brand-header([Learning Skills Reflection], [How have I demonstrated and improved these learning skills?])
#v(3pt)
#info-row()
#v(3pt)
#block(
  width: 100%,
  fill: paper,
  stroke: (left: 4pt + ink),
  inset: (x: 8pt, y: 3pt),
)[
  #text(size: 8.4pt, fill: ink)[E = Excellent   G = Good   S = Satisfactory   N = Needs Improvement. Use a specific example in each row.]
]
#v(4pt)

#skill-row([Responsibility], [Uses class time well, follows through, and completes agreed work without repeated reminders.])
#v(3pt)
#skill-row([Organization], [Keeps goals, tools, materials, files, and time organized so work can move forward.])
#v(3pt)
#skill-row([Independent Work], [Starts promptly, stays focused, uses resources, and attempts solutions before asking for help.])
#v(3pt)
#skill-row([Collaboration], [Listens, shares tools and space, contributes fairly, and helps the group succeed.])
#v(3pt)
#skill-row([Initiative], [Asks thoughtful questions, seeks feedback, notices what needs doing, and takes useful action.])
#v(3pt)
#skill-row([Self-Regulation], [Manages distractions, works safely, responds to feedback, and adjusts when something is not working.])
```
